channel.title: Blip incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Blip's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Blip Portal and Desk Loading Issues [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. The underlying configuration mapping errors, connection saturation, and TLS handshake failures have been fully addressed. All system services, messaging traffic, and affected clusters have been restored to full operation. Continuous monitoring remains active to ensure system stability.

item.title: Widespread Failure in Sending and Receiving Emails [resolved]
item.description: The email provider's corporate account experienced a temporary access block, affecting the delivery of login emails, reports, and system notifications. We have implemented the changes requested by the provider and are configuring additional safeguards for other platform features, as well as setting up preventive alerts to ensure a rapid response should the issue recur. We are implementing a new configuration to restructure workflows, ensuring that any email delivery inconsistencies do not impact or compromise other system functions. Preventive alert rules have been established to immediately notify the technical team if this behavior recurs with the provider. Communication channels and technical investigations involving both the provider and internal teams remain active to ensure the situa

item.title: Slowness or delays in bot responses [resolved]
item.description: We identified that customers were experiencing slow bot response times, with delays ranging from 10 seconds to a full minute. The technical team mobilized to validate the issue and investigate the environment's logs. We performed a rollback of the application update that had been intended to improve the platform. We appreciate everyone's patience and cooperation while we addressed this situation.

item.title: Message visibility issues in Blip Desk and Portal [resolved]
item.description: The environment has been fully restored to normal and is stable, with message flow and history back to normal. Our technical teams increased the processing capacity of the messaging queues to eliminate bottlenecks and resolved discrepancies regarding message history persistence. Normal operations were restored at 9:50 PM yesterday, and the system remained under continuous monitoring until 9:30 AM today to fully validate performance. The emergency response has concluded, and the platform remains under standard preventive monitoring.

item.title: WhatsApp Media Sending Instability [resolved]
item.description: The incident affecting media message delivery through the WhatsApp channel has been resolved. We observed a significant reduction in errors starting at approximately 13:50 (GMT-3), and subsequent validation tests were completed successfully without further issues. After further investigation, Meta informed us that an internal issue related to its Forward Proxy service had been identified and resolved. The service has remained stable since then, and no new impacts have been observed. This incident is now considered resolved.

item.title: Failure in the AI application [resolved]
item.description:
What happened and what was the impact on customers: We identified a failure in the AI application. As a result, customers experienced a failure in the messages from the AI-powered bots.
Actions taken: Update of the expired token Restart Rollout in all pods Monitoring of metrics after restarts
Failure occurrences: Start of failure: 11/12/2025 8:10 AM (GMT-3) Fault resolution: 11/12/2025 10:10 AM (GMT-3)
Root cause The failure was caused by instabilities resulting from expired credentials on an external service, which temporarily impacted the bot's operation.
